subject: Post-call: Clearline sizing next steps & proposed slots

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Clearline sizing next steps & proposed slots

Hi Alex — thanks again for the discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your Dedicated capacity sizing lined up:

Summary of needs we heard today:
- Primary use case: near-real-time fraud signal enrichment in transaction flow (pre-authorization)
- Target latency: <120ms p95 for single-token expansions in production
- Expected steady-state throughput: 200 QPS for embeddings + generation mix, spikes to 800 QPS during batch settlements
- Security: VPC/private deployment preferred; SOC2 evidence required

Next steps I propose:
1) Schedule a 60-minute technical sizing + ops deep dive to validate concurrency patterns and confirm GPU pool sizing (we'll bring infra + runtime engineer).
2) Fill the attached sizing questionnaire so we have precise traffic patterns before the call.
3) Provide a short list of sample prompts and sequence lengths (this helps kernel selection and KV-cache sizing).

Proposed 60-minute slots (PST):
- Wed Nov 3, 10:00–11:00 AM
- Thu Nov 4, 9:00–10:00 AM
- Fri Nov 5, 1:00–2:00 PM

Please reply with the best slot or propose alternatives. I attached a quick questionnaire and an .ics with the three slots to make booking easier.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales (West)
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: clearline_sizing_questionnaire.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: proposed_slots.ics (3 events)

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@clearline.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Clearline sizing next steps & proposed slots

Hi Naomi — appreciate the clear recap. Thu Nov 4 at 9am PST works for the team.

A couple quick clarifications before the deep dive so we can prep: 
- The 200 QPS steady-state is an average over business hours; the spike to 800 QPS is expected during overnight batch reconciliation (roughly a 15–30 minute window).
- Our prompts are typically short (average 40 tokens, max 220 tokens) but some enrichment responses can be longer.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood recommends a single multi-GPU pool or two separate pools (one for low-latency online, one for batch)?

I'll cc eng-team@clearline.com so they can join the call. I'll also upload a draft traffic-export to the Drive link you provided.

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
Head of Product
Clearline Finance
alex.ramos@clearline.com

Requested pre-call artifacts:
- Representative traffic trace (JSON or CSV) showing timestamps, request types, token counts, and response latencies (sample 1h and a peak 30m window).
- A short list (2–3) of sample prompts + expected max response lengths.
- Any NDAs or procurement docs we should share early.

What we'll bring to the call:
- A recommended GPU pool architecture (options: single mixed pool with priority routing vs. split online/batch pools), with ballpark cost and latency estimates.
- Quantization and batching profiles for your token distribution.
- A draft mutual action plan for Dedicated deployment and SOC2 evidence handoff.

I've attached the sizing questionnaire again (it's mostly traffic and retention questions) — please have your engs fill sections A/B before the meeting.
